expected_result: Exact duplicate is blocked

expected_result: Cooldown message appears

expected_result: Consolidated authorized CSWDO data is visible

expected_result: Access is denied

expected_result: Status becomes pending approval

test_scenario: Correct low-confidence sentiment
expected_result: Original label is retained and score recalculates

test_scenario: Create and decrypt encrypted backup
expected_result: Backup round trip succeeds

test_scenario: Open retention policy
expected_result: Configured periods and confirmation are shown

expected_result: Theme changes and persists

expected_result: All fields and controls remain readable and usable
